name: Nuki Smart Lock Pro 4th Gen (EU)

radios.note: Nuki's generations table lists built-in Wi-Fi and Matter over Thread for the Pro. CSA describes the lock as operated manually, via Bluetooth, Wi-Fi and Matter over Thread.

matter.note: CSA lists 'Nuki Smart Lock Pro (4th Generation)' (listing seen: firmware 1.4.0, hardware 7.07, certified 2025-04-23). Wi-Fi is used for the Nuki app and remote access, not for Matter.

apple_home.note: Matter over Thread; needs a Thread border router such as a HomePod mini or Apple TV 4K.

google_home.note: Nuki Web cloud integration through Works with Google. It needs remote access, which the Pro's built-in Wi-Fi provides, and a Nuki Web account. Nuki's help centre says voice locking and unlocking is currently not supported in Google Home. Matter over Thread is also supported.

alexa.note: Nuki Smart Home skill through Nuki Web. It needs remote access, which the Pro's built-in Wi-Fi provides, and a Nuki Web account; voice unlocking asks for a security code. Matter over Thread is also supported.

smartthings.note: Nuki lists Samsung SmartThings as a Matter hub. A Thread border router is needed.

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant's Nuki page says 4th generation Smart Locks support Matter over Thread and integrate through the Matter integration. Needs a Thread border router. MQTT is also documented.

hubRequired.note: Nuki says Pro models have a built-in Wi-Fi module, so remote access needs no extra accessory such as a Bridge. Matter control needs a Thread border router.

localControl.note: No Nuki source describes offline or local-only control explicitly.

lockFit.note: Mounts on the inside of the door over the existing Europrofile cylinder. The key only works from outside if the cylinder has an emergency function; Nuki sells a Universal Cylinder for doors whose cylinder does not.

keypad.note: No keypad on the lock. Nuki sells the Keypad 2 NFC as a separate accessory for its 4th-generation locks.

power.note: Nuki's rechargeable Power Pack, rated for up to 6 months per charge.

summary: Nuki's Smart Lock Pro (4th generation) mounts on the inside of a Europrofile cylinder and has Wi-Fi built in, so remote access needs no bridge. It speaks Matter over Thread for Apple Home, SmartThings and Home Assistant, and Google Home and Alexa also work through Nuki's cloud. A rechargeable Power Pack runs it, and the keypad is a separate accessory.
caveats: Matter needs a Thread border router, such as a HomePod mini or Apple TV 4K; Nuki's hub table shows which Echo devices work.
Nuki says voice locking and unlocking currently does not work in Google Home; app controls do.
Your key only works from outside if the cylinder has an emergency function.
The Keypad 2 NFC is a separate accessory.
Nuki launched a 5th-generation Smart Lock Pro in 2025; this page covers the 4th generation.
